per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  winner.name AS winner_name,
  winner.date_of_birth AS winner_dob,
  serena.date_of_birth AS serena_dob
FROM 
  tennis_tournaments t
JOIN 
  tennis_players winner ON t.winner_id = winner.player_id
JOIN 
  tennis_players serena ON serena.name = 'Serena Williams'
WHERE 
  t.tournament_name = 'Lorraine Open' AND t.year = 1980;
